top_signals.title: Copper to Hit Record as Tariff Concerns Distort Market, ANZ Says
top_signals.summary: Copper has the scope to rise to a record early next year as US tariff concerns combine with supply challenges at mines and resilient global demand, according to ANZ Group Holdings Ltd.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Sality, one of the longest-running botnets, finally gets disrupted
top_signals.summary: U.S. and European authorities disrupted the long-running botnet Sality, turning the malware’s peer-to-peer architecture against itself to cut thousands of infected computers off from operators.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

New Jersey asks Supreme Court to decide who regulates sports betting on prediction markets
top_signals.summary: New Jersey is asking the U.S. Supreme Court to settle, once and for all, how sports betting on prediction markets should be regulated.
